scope: Read-only assessment of the existing selected revised Transformer; recommendations are untested.

unknown_embedding.conclusion: UNK has zero training input occurrences. Its direction is unchanged to floating-point precision; its norm change matches ordinary AdamW decay. No task-supervised UNK adaptation is evidenced.

embedding_movement.caution: All ordinary task rows combined; no claim that representation movement is harmful.

optimization_history.slot_objective: Sequence CRF NLL summed then divided by real-token count

late_checkpoint_gradient_probe.sample: 512 original train records without replacement; seed 20261111; 16 batches of32
late_checkpoint_gradient_probe.mode: selected checkpoint, eval mode, autograd.grad only, no optimizer or weight update
late_checkpoint_gradient_probe.caution: Late-checkpoint local gradients with dropout disabled do not establish gradient behavior throughout training or prove benefit from any loss weighting.

postprocessing_recovery.reason: Default Tk backend failed to locate init.tcl after all 20 completed epochs and saved selected checkpoint.
postprocessing_recovery.action: Rendered retained genuine history with Agg and reproduced every development prediction in a fresh process. No training repeated; selected checkpoint unchanged.

existing_test_paired_bootstrap.limitations: Paired utterance bootstrap conditional on these frozen seed-42 checkpoints. Intervals reflect finite test-utterance sampling, not training-seed variation, and have no multiplicity adjustment. The target system was chosen on development before test; no test-driven retuning is permitted.

recommendation_order_not_measured_probab: Rare-word to UNK feature dropout retaining characters

limitations: One selected training seed; no seed-variance measurement or new candidate training.

Confidence calibration is not equivalent to classification accuracy.
